objective: Review the scoped Verilator-process-to-launcher bridge blocked run evaluation, accept process_to_launcher_bridge_failure as the honest failure class before runtime attempt start, and select the next implementation-boundary definition without over-claiming direct Verilator sidecar execution.

review_decision.reason: The run record separates reviewed bridge metadata readiness from runtime bridge execution. It records that reviewed process-to-launcher CLI evidence exists as a prerequisite, but the bridge path itself is blocked before runtime attempt start because it still lacks observable wrapper-mediated ordering before launcher start.
review_decision.weakest_point: The accepted process-to-launcher CLI run reached sidecar stages and coverage-output compare, but that was not started from the Verilator-process bridge path. Treating that prerequisite as bridge-path authority would overclaim direct Verilator sidecar execution.
accepted_because: the source run preserves process_to_launcher_bridge_failure rather than reporting success
reviewed bridge fixture metadata readiness is recorded separately from execution
reviewed process-to-launcher CLI metadata is tied to the bridge but remains prerequisite evidence
explicit sidecar context authority is validated and unreviewed context refs are rejected
observable bridge trace before launcher start is recorded as false
launcher start from the bridge path is recorded as false
bridge-path sidecar stages and bridge-path compare are recorded as false

direct Verilator sidecar execution, timing, broad native option support, automatic allocation, runtime/ABI change, arbitrary filelist support, raw-state equality, and production throughput remain non-claims

selected_next_workstream.name: define_verilator_native_option_parser_direct_command_path_native_invocation_verilator_process_launcher_bridge_observable_ordering_implementation_boundary_gate
selected_next_workstream.reason: The missing piece is not another metadata fixture or another separate launcher run. The next boundary must define the minimal callable implementation that emits observable wrapper-mediated bridge ordering before allowing runtime attempt start and before starting the reviewed launcher argv.
not_selected: timing measurement, because bridge-path launcher start does not exist yet
arbitrary filelist support, because the accepted scope remains pulp_ita_mha 64x1
automatic GPU allocation, because allocation policy needs a working bridge-path launcher start first
runtime or ABI changes, because this review only accepts a failure record
direct Verilator sidecar execution claims, because the bridge path still did not reach launcher start or compare
